paragraphs.source_en: “It’s a fraud, lads! Lead the way to him, himself!” shouted the tall youth. “Don’t let him go, lads! Let him answer us! Keep him!” shouted different people and the people dashed in pursuit of the trap.

paragraphs.source_en: Following the superintendent of police and talking loudly the crowd went in the direction of the Lubyánka Street.
